prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Design the first playable minute of an accessible Apple-platform puzzle game. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platforms: iPhone and Apple TV. Current prototype requires reading a long tutorial before play, uses color-only tiles and assumes touch dragging on every device. Losing forces a purchase screen. Sessions should be short and resumable.

criteria.task_completion: Specify learn-by-doing onboarding, clear goals/feedback and platform-appropriate controls with noncolor and adjustable-challenge alternatives; preserve progress and distinguish native game testing from a spec.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the designing-for-games guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Specify learn-by-doing onboarding, clear goals/feedback and platform-appropriate controls with noncolor and adjustable-challenge alternatives; preserve progress and distinguish native game testing from a spec.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Specify learn-by-doing onboarding, clear goals/feedback and platform-appropriate controls with noncolor and adjustable-challenge alternatives; preserve progress and distinguish native game testing from a spec.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
